## How to review

- **When to decide:** <!-- now, or after a named piece of evidence; the default -->

## Acceptance criteria
- `decisions/NNNN-title.md` with Context, Decision, Alternatives and Consequences, linked from this
  issue; its *Decided by* names the human who replied.
- Follow-up work issue on the board, per option: A: … / B: … / C: …

## Out of scope
- New simulations (the evidence lives in the linked reports).
- Implementing the choice (the follow-up work issue).
